goal: Implement the corrected KGEN 11520 mobile control semantics: the normal-axis energy rail is horizontally centered; C is a signed velocity ratio centered at 0 with +C mapping to 多 and -C mapping to 空; lot count stays positive; immersive fullscreen uses standards-based browser fullscreen where supported and otherwise consumes the actual visible viewport; LONG/SHORT colors are professionally configurable and persisted without changing trading semantics.

scope.normal_axis_energy_rail: At 390px width, the center of #yControl must be within 2px of viewport center. C and lot rails sit to its right without overlap.
signed_c: Dragging upward selects positive velocity +C and canonical 多 direction.
Dragging downward selects negative velocity -C and canonical 空 direction.
Negative C means opposite velocity direction; it does not create negative mass.
Lot count remains >=1 in the product UI and does not encode trade direction.
The existing canonical trade side is synchronized from C sign; the separate side toggle is disabled to prevent contradictory state.
Direction selection alone does not execute an order; existing confirmation remains mandatory.
trade_color_configuration: Default Taiwan preset is 多/LONG red and 空/SHORT green.
International preset is 多/LONG green and 空/SHORT red.
The selected preset is persisted in localStorage key k11520.trade.colorScheme.
C rail gradient, active C value and order-direction accent use shared LONG/SHORT CSS variables so the semantic colors cannot drift apart.
Changing color preset changes presentation only; it cannot change C sign, order side, lot count or execute an order.
immersive_mobile: Request Fullscreen API with navigationUI=hide when supported and user activation permits it.
Use VisualViewport height for the actual visible game canvas.
If fullscreen is unavailable or rejected, fail open to visible-viewport immersive mode with an explicit exit affordance.
Do not claim the page can forcibly hide every Facebook/in-app-browser toolbar or Android navigation surface.

machine_verifiable_acceptance: 390x844 real Chromium proves 0C/+C/-C behavior and canonical 多/空 synchronization.
Default color preset is TW_RED_LONG with LONG #ff4f5e and SHORT #35d07f.
Switching to GLOBAL_GREEN_LONG swaps LONG/SHORT colors and persists the selection; switching back through the settings selector restores TW_RED_LONG.
LONG and SHORT C states have visibly distinct computed colors.
Signed C reaches __K11520_COMBAT_DRIVE__.c, including negative values.
Fallback immersive mode matches VisualViewport height and exposes explicit exit.
Existing XZ+Y / XY+Z / YZ+X, character, action-rail, combat, living-world and screenshot gates remain mandatory.
merge_policy: R1 only. Merge only from exact latest main/head after required exact-head checks are green and no blocking comments/threads/races exist. Then verify post-merge exact main and Pages.
